title: Banco de Talentos GFT - QA Automação
description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.


Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir com a evolução das práticas de qualidade e engenharia de testes;
  • Participar de code reviews e disseminar boas práticas de testes.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Gerente de Marketing Digital
description:
LINK DO FORMULÁRIO PARA CADASTRAR-SE PARA VAGA:

Clique aqui > TypeformFaça parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Estruturar, organizar e otimizar funis de vendas de Direct Response (Front-end, Upsell, Downsell, Cross-sell e Order Bump);
  • Analisar métricas de conversão (CVR, AOV, CPA, LTV, lucro por lead);
  • Atualizar e consolidar indicadores de performance financeira dos funis (DRE por produto, margem, CMV, comissões e reembolsos);
  • Apoiar na montagem de projeções de fluxo de caixa por oferta;
  • Cruzar dados de diferentes plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways de pagamento, afiliados);
  • Analisar cenários de preço (A/B), impacto em AOV, lucro por lead e taxas de reembolso;
  • Identificar gargalos de conversão e propor testes estruturados;
  • Coordenar melhorias de funil junto às áreas de Copy, Video, Tech, Produto e Backend;
  • Organizar roadmap de projetos de funil e garantir entregas dentro do prazo;
  • Validar integrações entre checkout, CRM, e-mail, SMS e webhooks;
  • Apoiar na preparação de relatórios operacionais para diretoria (margem por produto, lucro por lead, eficiência de funil, performance de ofertas);
  • Participar ativamente da definição de prioridades estratégicas com base em dados.

QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Experiência sólida com funis de vendas
  • Excel / Google Sheets avançado – uso de fórmulas complexas para manipulação de grandes bases de dados;
  • Experiência com métricas de performance digital (AOV, CPA, CVR, LTV);
  • Experiência com demonstrativos financeiros aplicados a marketing (DRE por produto, margem de contribuição);
  • Experiência com modelagem de cenários para tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento de integrações entre plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways);
  • Elevado grau de responsabilidade com dados, indicadores e impacto financeiro;
  • Perfil analítico ativo: capacidade de interpretar resultados e propor soluções estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de HTML e lógica básica de JavaScript (edição de scripts, botões e redirecionamentos), configuração de webhooks e familiaridade com pixels, UTMs e validação de eventos.
  • Capacidade de debugar problemas de funil em produção (redirecionamentos, integrações e tracking), com autonomia para resolver falhas técnicas sem depender constantemente do time de TI.
  • Diferencial :
  • Experiência com mercado internacional e afiliados.
  • Se fluente em inglês.

COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • PROATIVIDADE
  • ANALÍTICO
  • FOCO EM RESULTADO
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO
  • CAPACIDADE DE PRIORIZAÇÃO
  • RESOLUTIVO
  • COMUNICAÇÃO CLARA

SALÁRIO:

  • A combinar
  • Bônus trimestral - Vale a partir do segundo Trimestre dentro da empresa.

TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office

COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:
About us:

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting

  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

description:
We are looking for contractor support to strengthen creative workflow operations. This person would not be focused on creative production itself, but on helping requests move efficiently through intake, scoping, setup, and handoff, while also supporting workflow improvements in Asana .

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary


Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and beyond. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We have a diverse, global team of consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.

As part of our growth and upcoming initiatives, we are searching for Senior Data Engineers to support future projects and platform modernization efforts across our client portfolio.


Position Summary


The Senior Data Engineer  will play a key role in supporting the transition and modernization of the client’s data platform. The position will focus on pipeline migration, operational stabilization, and the implementation of a dbt-based transformation framework  within a Snowflake environment.

  • Advanced/fluent english
  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake
  • Experience working with Apache Airflow
  • Strong SQL (advanced)  skills
  • Strong Python  programming skills
  • Experience building: ELT pipelines, Data warehouse transformations, Batch and incremental, pipelines, Data ingestion pipelines
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred)


Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing dbt
  • Experience with data platform migrations
  • Experience with data pipeline performance optimization

title: Ecommerce Email/SMS Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.


About Apex Brands:

We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month

title: Business Development Manager – Industrial Market
description:
Hikvision is the world's largest supplier of video surveillance products and solutions. The company specializes in video surveillance technology, as well as designing and manufacturing a full line of innovative CCTV and video surveillance products. Since its establishment in 2001, Hikvision has quickly achieved a leading worldwide market position in the security industry.


Hikvision possesses the world's largest R&D team and state-of-art manufacturing facilities; both allow Hikvision’s customers the benefit of world-class products that are designed with cutting-edge technology. The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.


Business Development Manager – Industrial Market


Country： Brazil

The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.

The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:


•Great business sense and market sense

•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market

•Great communication skills

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•A positive attitude

•Great negotiation skills

•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity


Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:


•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys

•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points

•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users

•Presentation of the solution to potential customers

•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.

•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team

•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.

•Assist consultants to specify projects

•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.

•Prepare reports required by the management.


Your Profile:


•Experience in the industrial market.

•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.

•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.

•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•Strong communication skills in English，both oral and written

•Solid in Outlook and related products.

title: Sr. Mainframe Developer (COBOL)
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Sr. Mainframe COBOL Developer to join an international project supporting a US client in the life insurance industry. This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to the maintenance, enhancement, and migration of critical mainframe-based insurance administration systems.



Main Challenges:


  • Maintain and enhance legacy mainframe systems written in Assembler and COBOL , working with VSAM file structures
  • Support and develop applications on the Ingenium platform (COBOL/DB2)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across multiple mainframe environments
  • Support ongoing data extraction and migration efforts toward a third-party administrator (TPA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and continuity
  • Provide knowledge transfer and documentation to preserve institutional knowledge


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience in mainframe development experience with COBOL (critical)
  • Hands-on experience with IBM Mainframe Assembler programming on z/OS
  • Proven background in life insurance or annuities systems (policy administration, claims, or billing)
  • Experience working with VSAM file structures on mainframe environments
  • Hands-on experience with DB2 on IBM mainframe
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in legacy/production environments
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English with US-based client teams


Preferred Background:


  • Familiarity with Ingenium or similar insurance administration platforms
  • Experience with data migration or system conversion projects
  • Exposure to CICS Transaction Gateway and Unix environments
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent


This role is especially relevant for professionals who have worked in life insurance mainframe environments, supported legacy system modernization, and are comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities in a direct, fast-paced team culture.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Senior QA Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Senior QA Data Engineer , who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

Lead QA initiatives for one or more projects, including planning, execution, and reporting.

Develop, maintain, and execute automated and manual test scripts, leveraging tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, and API testing frameworks.

Mentor and guide junior QA team members, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.

Analyze testing results, identify issues, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.

Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies, providing insights on testing progress and quality metrics. Identify scenarios suitable for automation, optimize testing strategies, and improve testing efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, and Stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.

Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring quick resolution and continuous improvement. Stay updated on industry best practices, testing tools, and methodologies.


Technical Skills & Knowledge:

Testing Strategies: Expertise in functional, integration, unit, regression, and exploratory testing. Automation & Scripting: Proficient in Java and Python; experience with Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, and API testing. Frameworks & Tools: Experience in creating custom test frameworks; familiarity with GitHub Copilot for automation.

Methodologies: Agile/Scrum experience, ISTQB CTFL certification is a plus.

Testing Approaches: Knowledge of BDD, web testing, and performance testing. Version Control & Management: Proficient in JIRA and GitHub. Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Strong problem-solving abilities with a creative and efficient mindset. Ability to work independently, self-manage, and adapt quickly to changing priorities. Team-oriented, collaborative, and proactive in seeking solutions and improvements. Organized and capable of planning testing activities effectively. Deep understanding of the product’s purpose and how testing contributes to overall quality. Qualifications: 3-5 years of experience in software QA or related fields. Advanced knowledge of testing tools and automation frameworks. ISTQB CTFL certification (preferred). Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and best practices


Mandatory Skills:

  • SQL
  • Python programming
  • Robot Framework -
  • Automate testing
  • BDD


Data Pipelines: Experience validating and testing ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and reliability.

Databases: Strong understanding of SQL and experience working with relational and/or cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar).

Data Processing: Familiarity with data transformation tools and frameworks (e.g., Python-based processing, Spark concepts, or equivalent).

Data Quality: Ability to define and implement data quality checks, reconciliation rules, and monitoring for anomalies.

APIs & Integration: Experience testing data integrations, APIs, and downstream consumers (dashboards, reports, or analytics use cases).

Cloud & DevOps (Nice to Have): Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines supporting data and test automation workflows.

Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Suporte a Aplicações SAP experiente, especializado em Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) e SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM), uma aplicação nativa em nuvem projetada para o SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.


Esta função tem como foco fornecer suporte de aplicação de Nível 2 / Nível 3 para o processamento completo (end-to-end) de faturas de fornecedores, garantindo operações estáveis, tratamento eficiente de exceções e melhoria contínua dos processos em ambientes SAP integrados.


Conhecimentos e Competências Necessárias:


  • Experiência com S/4 HANA e SAP Activate;
  • Inglês avançado (Mandatório);
  • Experiência em suporte a aplicações SAP, com forte atuação em Vendor Invoice Management;
  • Experiência prática (hands-on) no suporte ao SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM) em ambiente produtivo;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de ITSM.


Responsabilidades:


  • Suporte a Aplicações & Gestão de Incidentes:

Fornecer suporte a aplicações para SAP Vendor Invoice Management e SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM) em múltiplas unidades de negócio e códigos de empresa.


  • Solucionar problemas e resolver incidentes relacionados a:

Recebimento de faturas (invoice ingestion);

Extração via OCR e erros de validação;

Problemas de status de faturas;

Workflow, aprovações e tratamento de exceções.

Realizar análise de causa raiz (root cause analysis) e implementar correções sustentáveis em conformidade com SLAs e processos ITIL.

Oferecer suporte em períodos críticos de negócio sob demanda.


  • Configuração & Melhorias no CIM:

Configurar e dar suporte às definições de processamento de faturas no SAP Central Invoice Management, incluindo:

Tipos de fatura e serviços de processamento

Regras de negócio e validações

Configuração de workflows e aprovações

Apoiar melhorias e solicitações de mudança relacionadas à eficiência, conformidade e automação do processamento de faturas.


  • Colaborar com equipes ABAP e de integração para:

Interfaces entre o CIM e sistemas SAP backend

Tratamento de erros e monitoramento de fluxos de entrada de faturas


  • Integração & Processamento de Faturas de Entrada:

Dar suporte às integrações de faturas provenientes de:

SAP S/4HANA

Sistemas externos

Monitorar e dar suporte aos agendamentos de importação de faturas.

Auxiliar na resolução de falhas de integração e inconsistências de dados entre o CIM e sistemas ERP conectados.


  • Colaboração com Finanças & Negócio:

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Contas a Pagar, Finanças e Compras.

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou melhorias SAP.
  • Conhecimento de regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Certificação SAP FI (desejável).
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento em CO.
  • Diferencial: Inglês ou espanhol


Onde você irá trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido - Curitiba/PR.

O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.

title: SAP Tax Specialist
description:

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SAP Procure to Pay and Record to Report Tax Specialist to join our client's team in the technology sector. Technical

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: \"Analista Funcional de SAP ACM #993332\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento do Agronegócio.


Detalhes do projeto

Atuação em cliente do segmento de agronegócio (trading de commodities agrícolas), em um ambiente SAP S/4HANA, com utilização do módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management). O profissional fará parte de uma operação em modelo AMS (Application Management Services), com foco em suporte, sustentação e melhorias contínuas, interagindo com demais áreas.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no suporte funcional (nível L1/L2) ao módulo SAP ACM;
  • Apoiar na análise de erros;
  • Realizar validação de dados e troubleshooting funcional;
  • Apoiar na execução de testes funcionais (unitários e integrados);
  • Auxiliar em pequenas melhorias (changes) e ajustes de configuração;
  • Interagir com times técnicos para correção de problemas;
  • Apoiar usuários de negócio no entendimento e uso do sistema;
  • Registrar e manter documentação básica de soluções e procedimentos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência inicial com SAP (projetos, estágio ou AMS);
  • Noções de processos de negócio (compras, vendas, contratos);
  • Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com usuários e equipe técnica.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Conhecimento básico em algum módulo SAP (MM, SD, FI ou similar);
  • Noções de debug funcional ou leitura básica de código ABAP;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Backend Data Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a strong Backend Engineer who thrives in fast-moving environments and has a specialty in all things data. They are at an inflection point. Their product is live and working, customers are telling them what they need, and the engineering team is building rapidly.


You will work deep in complex backend systems and will be their go-to person for everything data-related: ingestion, modeling, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps it all running. This is not a data-first role that happens to touch the backend; it is a backend role where data mastery is your distinguishing edge.


What you'll do:

  • Design, build, optimize and maintain scalable features and systems across our Python/Django backend
  • Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to onboard, normalize, and continuously update third-party data sources that power our platform
  • Own data modeling and schema design across our platform, ensuring our data layer is structured for performance, flexibility, and long-term scale
  • Implement asynchronous and distributed processing to handle large-scale operations reliably and efficiently
  • Own data infrastructure tooling - including pipeline orchestration, storage, and warehousing - alongside application-layer development
  • Contribute to new product capabilities and integrations, working closely with other developers, AI engineers and data scientists
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO to define data strategy and technical architecture as the platform scales


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex backend systems in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and Django (or a comparable framework)
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows
  • Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems
  • Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing
  • Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs
  • Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset


Bonus points for:

  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems
  • Experience with the Django REST framework
  • Understanding of Terraform or cloud infrastructure as code
  • Experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, or regulated data environments


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal stage, shaping scalable data-driven systems and architecture.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Motion Graphics Editor
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,100 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly creative Motion Graphics Editor/Designer to create standout performance content across a diverse portfolio of leading consumer brands.


This is a hands-on thinker/doer role for someone who can design, edit, and animate polished creative in a fast-moving environment. The right person is not just a strong editor, but someone with real motion design ability, strong visual instincts, and a sharp eye for layout, typography, pacing, and UI-driven storytelling. You should be comfortable creating elevated, design-forward work that feels intentional, modern, and performance-minded.


You will work closely with their internal teams and external stakeholders to develop digital and social creative across platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and more. The ideal candidate understands direct response marketing, knows how to balance speed with craft, and is eager to push creative quality while staying aligned to performance goals.


What You’ll Do:

  • Create high-quality motion graphics with a strong design sensibility, including typography, layout, compositing, transitions, and UI-based animation
  • Build polished ad creative that blends brand storytelling with direct response best practices
  • Review footage and produce edits with strong narrative structure, pacing, and shot selection
  • Quickly assemble edits, iterate on concepts, and implement feedback from clients and internal teams under tight deadlines
  • Design and animate visual systems, graphics, and screen/UI moments that make creative feel elevated and intentional
  • Manage media and organize assets across Google Drive, Slack, Notion, and Asana
  • Quality control exports to ensure all deliverables meet creative standards, technical specs, brand guidelines, and deadlines
  • Complete and transfer final deliverables to clients and stakeholders accurately and on time


What You’ll Need:

  • 2–5 years of experience in motion design, video editing, and digital creative, ideally within a DTC agency or other fast-paced performance marketing environment
  • Advanced motion graphics skills with a strong design eye — this role requires someone who can create polished, high-end work, not just basic animation
  • Strong visual taste and attention to detail across typography, layout, composition, pacing, and overall creative polish
  • Experience designing and animating UI-inspired or screen-based visuals is strongly preferred
  • High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially After Effects and Premiere Pro
  • Strong understanding of post-production workflows, visual storytelling, and how to make creative feel premium while still performance-oriented
  • Comfortable working from scripts, briefs, or loose direction while maintaining a high level of craft and creative consistency
  • Strong understanding of social platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and what makes content perform in each environment
  • A sharp sense of culture, trends, and creative strategy, with the ability to turn insights into engaging, high-performing work
  • Strong English communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a proactive, self-directed approach


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to create high-impact, performance-driven creative for leading consumer brands in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Junior Media Buyer
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re Nooro - a fast-growing app company operating alongside a highly profitable eCommerce business, doing over $100M per year. 


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We need a Jr. Media Buyer to manage day-to-day campaign operations in our Meta ad account under the direction of our senior media buyer.


This is primarily a creative testing execution role. You will be inside Ads Manager daily building out new creative tests, launching ads, managing budgets, QA-ing everything before publish, and reporting on performance. Expect 90% of your time to be setting up and managing creative tests across client accounts.


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


RESPONSIBILITES

•    Build and launch new creative tests across multiple client accounts — new ad variations, copy iterations, hook tests, format tests (static, video, carousel, UGC), and angle tests

•    Structure creative tests properly within campaign architecture (CBO, ABO, ASC, Advantage+ Shopping) based on the testing framework set by the senior buyer

•    QA every ad before publish: UTM parameters, creative assets, copy, placements, audience targeting, conversion events, and tracking verification

•    Monitor Advantage+ Creative Enhancements and platform-level automation settings, applying the correct protocol per client and creative type

•    Execute daily budget adjustments, ad toggling, and bid changes based on performance thresholds

•    Pull and organize creative performance data for weekly reporting (ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, Thumbstop, Hold Rate) so winning and losing creatives are clearly identified

•    Flag anomalies: spend pacing issues, delivery problems, rejected ads, pixel firing errors

•    Communicate async via Slack with clear status updates, questions, and blockers


REQUIREMENTS

• 6+ months hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager (not boosted posts, not watching courses — actually building and managing campaigns)

• Understands campaign structures: CBO vs. ABO, broad vs. interest targeting, dynamic creative vs. standard ads

• Experience setting up creative tests and knows how to isolate variables (hook, angle, format, copy) without muddying results

• Familiar with Meta Pixel, CAPI, and event-based conversion tracking

• Can navigate Business Manager: ad accounts, pixels, product catalogs, partner access

• Detail-oriented — the kind of person who double-checks UTMs and preview links before anything goes live

• Reliable async communicator. PST working hours required.


NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

• Experience with DTC/ecommerce brands

• Basic understanding of landing page CRO and how it connects to ad performance

• Comfortable with Google Sheets and Power BI for data pulls and reporting


This is a straightforward execution role with clear systems and expectations. We value precision, speed, and reliability.


Apply ONLY if you're looking for a full-time role in the long run, not a quick gig.

title: Junior Media Buyer
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re Nooro - a fast-growing app company operating alongside a highly profitable eCommerce business, doing over $100M per year. 


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We need a Jr. Media Buyer to manage day-to-day campaign operations in our Meta ad account under the direction of our senior media buyer.


This is primarily a creative testing execution role. You will be inside Ads Manager daily building out new creative tests, launching ads, managing budgets, QA-ing everything before publish, and reporting on performance. Expect 90% of your time to be setting up and managing creative tests across client accounts.


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


RESPONSIBILITES

•    Build and launch new creative tests across multiple client accounts — new ad variations, copy iterations, hook tests, format tests (static, video, carousel, UGC), and angle tests

•    Structure creative tests properly within campaign architecture (CBO, ABO, ASC, Advantage+ Shopping) based on the testing framework set by the senior buyer

•    QA every ad before publish: UTM parameters, creative assets, copy, placements, audience targeting, conversion events, and tracking verification

•    Monitor Advantage+ Creative Enhancements and platform-level automation settings, applying the correct protocol per client and creative type

•    Execute daily budget adjustments, ad toggling, and bid changes based on performance thresholds

•    Pull and organize creative performance data for weekly reporting (ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, Thumbstop, Hold Rate) so winning and losing creatives are clearly identified

•    Flag anomalies: spend pacing issues, delivery problems, rejected ads, pixel firing errors

•    Communicate async via Slack with clear status updates, questions, and blockers


REQUIREMENTS

• 6+ months hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager (not boosted posts, not watching courses — actually building and managing campaigns)

• Understands campaign structures: CBO vs. ABO, broad vs. interest targeting, dynamic creative vs. standard ads

• Experience setting up creative tests and knows how to isolate variables (hook, angle, format, copy) without muddying results

• Familiar with Meta Pixel, CAPI, and event-based conversion tracking

• Can navigate Business Manager: ad accounts, pixels, product catalogs, partner access

• Detail-oriented — the kind of person who double-checks UTMs and preview links before anything goes live

• Reliable async communicator. PST working hours required.


NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

• Experience with DTC/ecommerce brands

• Basic understanding of landing page CRO and how it connects to ad performance

• Comfortable with Google Sheets and Power BI for data pulls and reporting


This is a straightforward execution role with clear systems and expectations. We value precision, speed, and reliability.


Apply ONLY if you're looking for a full-time role in the long run, not a quick gig.

This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.

  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).

  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.
