title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana

  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;

  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

Advanced English

title: Performance Marketing  Specialist
description:
Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it. Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!


We are seeking a Performance Marketing Specialist to lead our paid user acquisition efforts across B2C and lead acquisition for B2B. In an increasingly complex SaaS environment, you will operate as a high-impact IC, owning all paid marketing channels.


This role’s responsibilities will include search engine marketing (SEM / PPC), social media marketing (SMM), budget management, lead generation, keyword research, measuring data and analytics, working cross functionally with Sales and Product Marketing, and more. A key focus will be leveraging AI and new tooling to drive efficiency and scale.

This role reports directly to the Senior Lead of Acquisition.


Responsibilities:

  • Direct strategy and execution of all paid acquisition across B2C and B2B
  • Work cross functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Brand & Content, and more
  • Set and manage monthly and quarterly budgets and goals for paid marketing
  • Own SEM, SMM, OTT, Reddit, and all other paid marketing channels
  • Implement and oversee marketing automation and advanced tooling to streamline workflows
  • A/B test new channels, ad types, messaging/targeting, and more
  • Be data-driven, keeping us honest to monthly and quarterly goals for paid growth


Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of paid marketing experience
  • 3 years of experience owning Paid Search (SEM)
  • 3 years of experience owning Paid Social (SMM)
  • Experience owning large marketing budgets (8 figures annually)
  • Strong experience in both B2C and B2B acquisition
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Confident in pushing back on \"bad ideas\" or low-impact requests through data-backed reasoning
  • Experience in SaaS is a plus


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in R$ (BRL).

This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s team based in Brazil and in the United States.

description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

title: \"Analista Funcional de SAP ACM #993332\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento do Agronegócio.


Detalhes do projeto

Atuação em cliente do segmento de agronegócio (trading de commodities agrícolas), em um ambiente SAP S/4HANA, com utilização do módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management). O profissional fará parte de uma operação em modelo AMS (Application Management Services), com foco em suporte, sustentação e melhorias contínuas, interagindo com demais áreas.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no suporte funcional (nível L1/L2) ao módulo SAP ACM;
  • Apoiar na análise de erros;
  • Realizar validação de dados e troubleshooting funcional;
  • Apoiar na execução de testes funcionais (unitários e integrados);
  • Auxiliar em pequenas melhorias (changes) e ajustes de configuração;
  • Interagir com times técnicos para correção de problemas;
  • Apoiar usuários de negócio no entendimento e uso do sistema;
  • Registrar e manter documentação básica de soluções e procedimentos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência inicial com SAP (projetos, estágio ou AMS);
  • Noções de processos de negócio (compras, vendas, contratos);
  • Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com usuários e equipe técnica.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Conhecimento básico em algum módulo SAP (MM, SD, FI ou similar);
  • Noções de debug funcional ou leitura básica de código ABAP;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Especialista em Departamento Pessoal (DP)
description:
Pronto para construir o futuro com IA?

Na Genpact, não apenas acompanhamos a tecnologia - definimos o ritmo. A IA e a inovação digital estão redefinindo as indústrias, e estamos liderando ess a mudança. A AI Gigafactory da Genpact, nossa aceleradora pioneira, é um exemplo de como estamos dimensionando soluções de tecnologia avançada para ajudar empresas globais a trabalhar de maneira mais inteligente, crescer mais rápido e se transformar em escala. De modelos em larga escala a IA agente, nossas soluções inovadoras enfrentam os desafios mais complexos das empresas.

Se você se destaca em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador , adora criar implementar soluções de IA de ponta e deseja ultrapassar os limites do possível, este é o seu momento.

A Genpact (NYSE: G) é uma empresa de serviços e soluções de tecnologia avançada que oferece valor duradouro para empresas líderes em todo o mundo. Por meio de nosso profundo conhecimento de negócios, excelência operacional e soluções de ponta, ajudamos empresas de todos os setores a progredir e permanecer à frente. Impulsionadas pela curiosidade, coragem e inovação, nossas equipes implementam dados, tecnologia e IA para criar o amanhã, hoje. Conheça-nos no genpact.com e no LinkedIn, X, YouTube e Facebook.


VAGA EXTENSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA (PCD)

Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Departamento Pessoal (DP) para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este profissional será responsável por processos estratégicos e operacionais dentro da área de DP.


Responsabilidades :


• Rescisões: Realizar o processamento de rescisões de contrato (30-40 rescisões mensais), garantindo conformidade com a legislação trabalhista.

• Férias: Gerir o processo de férias, incluindo pagamento quinzenal (8-9 tickets mensais).

• Admissões e Movimentações: Coordenar e registrar admissões (30-40 mensais) e movimentações de colaboradores, com suporte no processo de integração.

• Homologações: Gerenciar homologações de rescisões com sindicatos e entidades competentes.

• Preenchimento da CAT: Responsável pelo preenchimento correto e no prazo da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho (CAT).

• Gestão de Chamados: Atuar na gestão de chamados no ServiceNow (aproximadamente 250 chamados mensais), assegurando o acompanhamento e solução dentro do prazo.

• Ferramentas: Utilizar SAP, Workday, e-Social, FGTs Digital para processamento de dados, cálculos e registros trabalhistas.

• Compliance: Garantir que todos os processos estejam em conformidade com as normas trabalhistas e regulamentações do país.


Qualificações:

• Sólida experiência com Departamento Pessoal, com foco em rescisões, admissões, férias, movimentações e homologações.

• Conhecimento avançado em SAP, ServiceNow, Workday e e-Social.

• Expertise no preenchimento de CAT e outros documentos relacionados a DP.

• Capacidade para lidar com alto volume de processos (250 chamados mensais e múltiplos processos simultâneos).

• Comunicação eficaz com equipes internas, colaboradores e sindicatos.

• Conhecimentos intermediários em inglês (não obrigatório, mas desejável).

• Habilidade em gestão de processos e resolução de problemas.



Por que se juntar à Genpact?

  • Lidere a transformação da IA em primeiro lugar – Crie e dimensione soluções de IA que redefinem os setores
  • Cause impacto – Impulsione a mudança para empresas globais e resolva os desafios de negócios que importam
  • Acelere sua carreira : ganhe experiência prática, treinamento de classe mundial, orientação e certificações de IA para aprimorar suas habilidades
  • Cresça com os melhores – Aprenda com os melhores engenheiros, cientistas de dados e especialistas em IA em um local de trabalho dinâmico e em rápida evolução
  • Comprometido com a IA ética – Trabalhe em um ambiente onde governança, transparência e segurança estejam no centro de tudo o que construímos
  • Prospere em uma cultura orientada por valores – Nossa coragem, curiosidade e incisividade - construídas sobre uma base de integridade e inclusão - permitem que suas ideias impulsionem o progresso.

Venha se juntar aos 140.000+ programadores, formadores de tecnologia e criadores de crescimento da Genpact e leve sua carreira na única direção que importa: para cima.

Vamos construir o amanhã juntos.

title: Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient software applications. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.


Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot across frontend and backend layers;
  • Architect and implement robust RESTful APIs, real-time data integrations, and high-performance backend services with proper caching and optimization strategies;
  • Build modern, responsive, and highly interactive user interfaces, integrating streaming data, advanced search, and filtering capabilities;
  • Contribute to system design decisions, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments while ensuring high engineering standards and best practices.


Essential Skills


  • Experience with strong full-stack expertise in both frontend and backend;
  • Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including strong CSS skills (Flexbox, Grid, responsive design);
  • Experience with UI frameworks such as MUI, Tailwind, or Ant Design, and solid frontend testing experience;
  • Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot, designing and building scalable, secure RESTful APIs;
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis);
  • Strong understanding of system design principles, caching mechanisms, and performance optimization in distributed systems;
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and real-time or streaming data solutions;
  • Hands-on experience with message brokers such as Kafka and search technologies like Elasticsearch;
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS preferred; GCP, Azure, or OCI acceptable);
  • Strong knowledge of Git and GitHub workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines including GitHub Actions.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Desenvolvedor Front-end Web & Mobile Senior
description:

Você é apaixonado(a) por desenvolvimento frontend e quer atuar na construção de experiências digitais em um projeto crítico do mercado financeiro?


Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar na evolução de aplicações Web e Mobile dentro do ecossistema de meios de pagamento, impactando diretamente a jornada de usuários em produtos de cartões de crédito.


Na IT Singular, acreditamos que tecnologia e experiência do usuário caminham juntas para criar soluções eficientes, seguras e intuitivas. Somos guiados pelo selo #HumanInside


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Web/Mobile para atuar na atualização e evolução de interfaces, garantindo excelência na experiência do usuário durante a transição para um novo emissor de cartões.


Você terá um papel essencial na construção de jornadas fluidas, integrações com APIs e implementação fiel de designs, com foco em performance, acessibilidade e qualidade.


➡️ Veja se essa oportunidade faz sentido para o seu próximo desafio profissional ⬇️


O que buscamos em você?

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Front-end para Web e Mobile

• Vivência no mercado de meios de pagamento (especialmente cartões de crédito) ⭐

• Proficiência em frameworks modernos (React, React Native, Flutter, Angular ou Vue)

• Experiência com consumo de APIs RESTful e integração de sistemas

• Conhecimento em boas práticas de UI/UX, acessibilidade e responsividade

• Capacidade de escrever código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção


Diferenciais que somam pontos

• Experiência em processadoras de cartões ⭐

• Conhecimento básico de backend (Java, Quarkus)

• Experiência com testes automatizados no frontend (Jest, Cypress ou similares)

• Familiaridade com fluxos de onboarding e ativação de cartões em apps financeiros


O que você fará no dia a dia?

• Atualizar interfaces Web e Mobile com dados do novo emissor (cartão virtual, textos regulatórios e informações legais)

• Implementar e otimizar jornadas do cliente durante a transição de cartões

• Integrar o frontend com APIs desenvolvidas pelo time de Core & Integrações

• Trabalhar em conjunto com UX/UI para garantir fidelidade ao design system

• Garantir responsividade, acessibilidade e performance das aplicações

• Participar de code reviews e promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento


Atuação consultiva e técnica

• Contribuir para evolução da experiência do usuário em produtos financeiros

• Garantir qualidade e consistência nas interfaces

• Apoiar decisões com foco em usabilidade, performance e escalabilidade

• Promover boas práticas de frontend e integração com backend


Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos um(a) profissional com olhar apurado para experiência do usuário, qualidade de código e atenção aos detalhes, que consiga atuar em produtos críticos com alto impacto.

Alguém que:

• Tenha senso de dono sobre as entregas

• Seja organizado(a) e atento(a) aos detalhes

• Tenha postura colaborativa com times multidisciplinares

• Seja proativo(a) na resolução de problemas

• Tenha interesse em evoluir tecnicamente e acompanhar boas práticas

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Criar análises e relatórios a partir de diferentes fontes de dados, com foco em gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Construir e manter modelos de dados eficientes (camadas analíticas, camada semantica, views, data marts).
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas como DBT, SQL, Python e ambientes como BigQuery ou Redshift.
  • Criar e documentar transformações de dados com boas práticas de versionamento e testes.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, analistas e product managers para garantir dados confiáveis.
  • Desenvolver dashboards (ex: Metabase, Looker) para visualização de métricas e KPIs.
  • Apoiar a criação de pequenos modelos preditivos ou análises estatísticas simples quando necessário.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de transformação de dados como DBT ou equivalente.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises exploratórias e criar relatórios com storytelling.
  • Noções de Python para análises e automações básicas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto e negócio: entender o \"porquê\" por trás dos dados.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de versionamento e qualidade de dados.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Experiência com modelos preditivos simples (ex: churn, scoring, clustering).
  • Experiência em ambientes com DataOps ou MLOps.
  • Conhecimento em testes de dados (ex: dbt tests, Great Expectations).
  • Experiência explorando e analisando dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, entendendo as demandas do negócio por meio de conversas com stakeholders.
  • Vivência traduzindo os resultados por meio de relatórios e dashboards em ferramentas como Looker ou Metabase.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Ajuda de custo para o remoto;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique pelo LinkedIn

title: Data Engineer/ Data Architect
description:
About the position

The senior-level position will be part of the our client team business intelligence solution that brings data from multiple products onto one platform enabling analysis and data-driven insights.


Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool.


The ideal candidate should be able to design data pipelines (not only build them), make architectural decisions, understand data flows end-to-end, and work beyond ticket-based execution.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Pipeline Design (not just implementation)

  • Define how pipelines should be built (not only execute them)
  • Design ingestion, transformation (ELT), and delivery strategies
  • Ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance

Data Architecture & Data Flows

  • Understand and design full data flows end-to-end
  • Work with modern data architectures (ELT, distributed systems)
  • Make decisions on data modeling and storage

Cloud-to-Cloud Migrations

  • Work on data migrations across cloud environments
  • Optimize movement and transformation of large datasets
  • Ensure reliability and performance during migrations

Optimization & Performance

  • Optimize SQL queries and data pipelines
  • Improve efficiency and reduce processing costs
  • Identify bottlenecks and propose scalable solutions

Production Troubleshooting (Critical)

  • Investigate issues such as incorrect data in dashboards
  • Trace problems across the full pipeline (ingestion → transformation → BI)
  • Provide structured root cause analysis and resolution

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines (end-to-end ownership)
  • Design and optimize transformation logic and SQL processes
  • Work on database architecture and distributed systems
  • Ensure data quality, validation, and reliability
  • Monitor pipelines and troubleshoot production issues
  • Integrate data from APIs and multiple systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Take technical decisions, not just execute tasks

Required Skills

Core

  • Strong SQL and Python
  • End-to-end pipeline experience
  • Data modeling and architecture understanding
  • LEVEL ENGLISH B2

Cloud (Very Important)

  • Experience with AWS 5+ years
  • Preferably strong and recent AWS experience
  • Hands-on experience (not just exposure)

Technical Depth

  • ETL / ELT processes
  • APIs and integrations
  • Distributed systems

Problem Solving (Critical)

  • Troubleshooting in production
  • Debugging pipelines and dashboards
  • Structured and analytical thinking

Ideal Candidate

  • Has hands-on experience building pipelines
  • Thinks beyond execution (design + architecture)
  • Understands data end-to-end
  • Has worked on real production issues
  • Can explain technical decisions clearly

What the client is really looking for

  • Design pipelines, not just build them
  • Think like a data architect
  • Solve real production problems
  • Operate as a senior-level engineer with ownership

Additional Benefits

  • Contract type CONTRACTOR
  • Rate: We are open to negotiating and listening to tariff proposals.
  • Contract without an expiration date (Not per project)
  • 100% remote modality in LATAM.
  • Career plan and continuous training.
  • Flexible work environment and excellent working environment.
  • Respect for your country's official holidays.

Would you like to participate?

title: Strategy Consultant | Ex-McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, KPMG (100% remote)
description:
Apply here:



About the role

We are looking for a sharp, execution-oriented strategy professional to work directly with C-suite clients across multiple industries. You will own workstreams end-to-end, from problem structuring and hypothesis development to stakeholder alignment and final delivery.


This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role designed for professionals who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually demanding environments and who are used to that standard from tier-1 consulting firms.


Who we're looking for:

Professionals with a background in top-tier global strategy or management consulting firms (McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, KPMG, PwC, EY, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, or equivalent). The rigor, structure, and pace expected here mirrors what you already know.


What you will do:

  • Lead hypothesis-driven diagnostic and strategy engagements for clients across sectors
  • Own workstream delivery: structuring the problem, building the analytical framework, and presenting findings to senior leadership
  • Drive C-suite and board-level stakeholder management with executive communication and influence
  • Translate complex data and qualitative insights into clear, actionable strategic recommendations
  • Support business development conversations and contribute to proposal writing when relevant
  • Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional, globally distributed teams

  • 3-8 years of experience in a top-tier strategy or management consulting firm (MBB, Big4 Strategy, or equivalent tier-1 firm)
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive engagement delivery from kickoff to final output

  • Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to C-level executives

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. 1. Good experience with EDR solutions (Trend Micro, CrowdStrike, Sentinel One, Microsoft)

Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Business Development Manager – Industrial Market
description:
Hikvision is the world's largest supplier of video surveillance products and solutions. The company specializes in video surveillance technology, as well as designing and manufacturing a full line of innovative CCTV and video surveillance products. Since its establishment in 2001, Hikvision has quickly achieved a leading worldwide market position in the security industry.


Hikvision possesses the world's largest R&D team and state-of-art manufacturing facilities; both allow Hikvision’s customers the benefit of world-class products that are designed with cutting-edge technology. The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.


Business Development Manager – Industrial Market


Country： Brazil

The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.

The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:


•Great business sense and market sense

•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market

•Great communication skills

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•A positive attitude

•Great negotiation skills

•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity


Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:


•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys

•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points

•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users

•Presentation of the solution to potential customers

•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.

•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team

•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.

•Assist consultants to specify projects

•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.

•Prepare reports required by the management.


Your Profile:


•Experience in the industrial market.

•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.

•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.

•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•Strong communication skills in English，both oral and written

•Solid in Outlook and related products.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
We’re looking for a high-output Social Media Manager to manage and scale a multi-platform presence across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd TikTok/IG/YouTube accounts, while handling community, growth hacking, and strategic outreach.


This is not a basic posting job — you’ll be responsible for running an entire content ecosystem, growing brand authority, and increasing reach through multi-language posting, cross-platform virality, and strategic relationship building.


We do not look for resumes - we only look for responses - fill this out:



✅ Responsibilities:


Platform Management


  • Warm up new TikTok/IG accounts using safe, proven methods (device + IP hygiene, watch time farming, etc.)
  • Run and manage 2nd and 3rd TikTok/IG/YT channels as clones with unique variation
  • Post daily on all socials, including:

  • TikTok (main + burner accounts)
  • Instagram (Reels + Feed)
  • YouTube (Shorts + Long form)
  • Twitter/X
  • Threads
  • Whop
  • Use Trial Reels or other tools for automated reel deployment & A/B testing


Whop Account Management


  • Post and manage Whop page & community
  • Keep offers updated, moderate access, and keep the page converting
  • Build Discord/Telegram (if needed) to support community management


Outreach & Guest Booking


  • Email 20–50 podcasts / influencers per week to pitch appearances or collabs
  • Track and schedule inbound interest
  • Draft outreach templates and continually optimize response rates


Promotion & Paid Growth


  • Identify top TikTok/IG pages for paid promo
  • Execute $10–$100 daily promos on viral accounts
  • Track ROI from shoutouts, reposts, and growth boosts


 Qualifications:


  • Proven experience growing multi-channel social media brands
  • Strong understanding of TikTok growth strategies, including warmup methods and shadowban prevention
  • Experience with posting tools like Metricool, Later, Hootsuite, etc.
  • Comfortable managing up to 5–7 sub-accounts at once
  • Familiarity with Whop or similar community/payment platforms
  • Organized, proactive, and consistent in follow-through
  • Bonus: Can write captions, titles, and CTAs that actually convert

title: Analista de QA
description:
Buscamos um profissional com forte viés analítico e orientação a dados , capaz de garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados que alimentam nossas soluções.


Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com desenvolvedores e Product Owners desde o refinamento técnico
  • Identificar, documentar e acompanhar o ciclo de vida das inconsistências e falhas identificadas nos processos e fluxos
  • Garantir a manutenção e evolução do nosso framework de automação
  • Promover a cultura de qualidade dentro do squad, disseminando boas práticas


Competências técnicas essenciais:

  • SQL para consulta, validação e auditoria de dados
  • JSON para análise e validação de payloads em integrações e APIs
  • Python para automação de validações e manipulação de dados
  • Capacidade de mapear e documentar processos de dados (pipelines, fluxos de ingestão, transformação e entrega)


Competências comportamentais:

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes na gestão de processos e casos de teste
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação com clientes internos e externos sobre qualidade, requisitos e inconsistências de dados
  • Perfil investigativo, proativo e orientado à resolução de problemas


Desejável:

  • Experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em SEO — faz parte do plano de desenvolvimento da equipe para os próximos ciclos, sendo um diferencial, mas não bloqueante para a contratação
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas do ecossistema de dados (ex: dbt, Great Expectations, Postman, ferramentas de observabilidade de dados)

description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.

ATIVIDADES


  • Monitorar e prestar suporte aos processos de recebimento de mercadorias e movimentações de estoque no SAP.

  • Realizar alinhamentos e governança dos atendimentos de chamados com áreas clientes e equipe de TI, promovendo melhorias contínuas no suporte.
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade técnica e produzir especificações funcionais e técnicas para resolução de causas raízes de erros sistêmicos.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das demandas e realizar follow-ups dos planos de ação, assegurando a execução dos testes pelas áreas de negócio.


REQUISITOS


  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em TI, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Necessário:
  • Experiência em suporte ao módulo SAP MM (Materials Management).
  • Domínio dos processos de Escrituração Fiscal, Movimentação de Mercadorias e Pedidos de Compras no SAP.
  • Conhecimento das rotinas das áreas Fiscal, Logística e Supply Chain.

title: Ecommerce Email/SMS Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.


About Apex Brands:

We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month


To be considered for this role please apply and follow/connect with our CEO (Andrew Giessinger):

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level?


At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video.


We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment.



Your Goals

  • Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences).
  • Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels.
  • Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages).
  • Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts.
  • Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners.


Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count).
  • Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot).
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment.



Benefits

  • Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team.
  • Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded.
  • Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video.
  • Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path.
  • 100% Remote position working with a global team.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit.


About Us

Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Junior Media Buyer
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re Nooro - a fast-growing app company operating alongside a highly profitable eCommerce business, doing over $100M per year. 


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We need a Jr. Media Buyer to manage day-to-day campaign operations in our Meta ad account under the direction of our senior media buyer.


This is primarily a creative testing execution role. You will be inside Ads Manager daily building out new creative tests, launching ads, managing budgets, QA-ing everything before publish, and reporting on performance. Expect 90% of your time to be setting up and managing creative tests across client accounts.


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


RESPONSIBILITES

•    Build and launch new creative tests across multiple client accounts — new ad variations, copy iterations, hook tests, format tests (static, video, carousel, UGC), and angle tests

•    Structure creative tests properly within campaign architecture (CBO, ABO, ASC, Advantage+ Shopping) based on the testing framework set by the senior buyer

•    QA every ad before publish: UTM parameters, creative assets, copy, placements, audience targeting, conversion events, and tracking verification

•    Monitor Advantage+ Creative Enhancements and platform-level automation settings, applying the correct protocol per client and creative type

•    Execute daily budget adjustments, ad toggling, and bid changes based on performance thresholds

•    Pull and organize creative performance data for weekly reporting (ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, Thumbstop, Hold Rate) so winning and losing creatives are clearly identified

•    Flag anomalies: spend pacing issues, delivery problems, rejected ads, pixel firing errors

•    Communicate async via Slack with clear status updates, questions, and blockers


REQUIREMENTS

• 6+ months hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager (not boosted posts, not watching courses — actually building and managing campaigns)

• Understands campaign structures: CBO vs. ABO, broad vs. interest targeting, dynamic creative vs. standard ads

• Experience setting up creative tests and knows how to isolate variables (hook, angle, format, copy) without muddying results

• Familiar with Meta Pixel, CAPI, and event-based conversion tracking

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.

Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month
